name: ALS Limited
summary: ALS Limited engages in the provision of professional technical services and analytical services primarily in the areas of testing, measurement, and inspection in Africa, Asia Pacific, Europe, the Middle East, North Africa, and the United States. It operates in two segments: Commodities and Life Sciences. The Commodities segment offers assaying and analytical testing, and metallurgical services for mining and mineral exploration companies. Its testing and consulting services cover the resource life cycle, including exploration, feasibility, optimization, production, design, development, trade, and rehabilitation.
